test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence In active voice.**

Pudding had already been prepared by her.
solution:
The correct active voice is: **She had already prepared pudding.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is written in the passive voice.
 
• To convert this sentence to active voice, we need to make the subject of the sentence the doer of the action.
 
• Identify the subject, verb, and object:
 
 
• **Subject**: Pudding
 
• **Verb**: had been prepared
 
• **Object**: by her
 
 
 
• Determine the doer of the action (agent):
 
 
• The doer of the action is "**her**."
 
 
 
• Construct the active voice sentence:
 
 
• **Subject**: She (the doer of the action)
 
• **Verb**: had already prepared
 
• **Object**: pudding
 
 
 
• So, the active voice sentence is: *"**She had already prepared pudding.**"*

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**She has already prepared pudding**" is in the present perfect tense and is not in active voice.
 
• "**She have already prepared pudding**" is grammatically incorrect as the subject "she" requires the singular verb "has" or "had."
 
• "**She will prepare pudding**" is in the future tense and is not in an active voice.
